business_problem: Sanwa Comtec needed to add AI-based harassment detection to on-premises chat deployments for customers that cannot send sensitive conversations to external networks, while still achieving enough accuracy to make alerts useful and compliant.
solution_summary: Sanwa Comtec built an on-premises harassment-detection capability for Rocket.Chat customers by combining IBM watsonx.ai with IBM Watson natural language processing classification functions. Working with legal experts, the team assembled training examples for sexual and power-based harassment, evaluated multiple models in a proof of concept and selected the most effective approach for a custom classifier. The resulting model runs inside a closed environment so organizations with strict network restrictions can analyze chat content without exposing it to public cloud services. By focusing on lightweight language models that can be packaged on premises, Sanwa Comtec and IBM turned watsonx.ai from a generic model-development environment into a deployable moderation component that fits regulated enterprise communication stacks. The team continues to refine training data and application logic as they move the solution toward production.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Hosts the custom harassment-detection model that classifies risky chat conversations in secure environments.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson natural language processing
solution_components.role: Provides the classification capability Sanwa Comtec used to train and evaluate harassment-detection models.

data_flow: Chat messages from on-premises Rocket.Chat deployments are processed by a custom classifier built in watsonx.ai with IBM Watson NLP, which scores conversations for likely harassment and generates alerts without sending sensitive content to external networks.
business_outcome: Sanwa Comtec created a secure, on-premises moderation capability that helps customers detect problematic conversations more accurately while preserving data sovereignty and supporting future production rollout.
